### Current strategy: `e63_lowcorr_every126`
- 1Day bars, promoted 2026-10-15, source [strategies/candidates/e63_lowcorr_every126.py](https://github.com/jadefjestad/trader-dark-factory/blob/main/strategies/candidates/e63_lowcorr_every126.py).
- Method: Hypothesis: holding the low-downside-correlation sleeve longer helped steadily (10 days worse, 42 days val 1.47, 63 days val 1.80 and promoted in PR #241). A 126-day (half-year) hold checks whether the gain keeps growing or 63 days is near the peak.
